release_controls.note: Overlaps the source regression; counts are not additive.

historical_evidence: Original certificates, snapshots and logs are preserved. The v5 metadata remains immutable; v6 has a separate release record.
limits: Finite computation with written proof arguments; no human peer-review or proof-assistant verification claim. Raw coverage includes unrelated imported modules and is not a whole-repository metric.
final_public_artifact_verification: All three public Zenodo downloads match local SHA256, MD5 and byte length; see publication.json.
